document_dispositions.rationale: The complete 49,860-character IBK report was reviewed against the durable current ledger. Its six objective-local valuation observations are already represented as accepted facts from this exact document: Samsung Electronics' relative discount to the market and Micron, the shared 10x operating-profit valuation frame, Samsung Electronics and SK hynix forward-multiple profiles, and the two applied-PBR anchors. Remaining target-price, forecast, price-performance, and non-Samsung passages are either semantically duplicative of those durable facts or do not add a distinct fact to the sole valuation_rerating objective.
